reel_angle.fan_question: How did Bayern lose a game they controlled: 1-0 up, 64.7% of the ball?
reel_angle.data_answer: They had the ball but not the chances: 0.25 xG from open play (Lille 2.06), 0.93 of their 1.18 xG from set pieces. After half-time Bayern's xG fell from 1.00 to 0.20 while Lille's rose from 0.57 to 1.55; BBC momentum gave Lille 16 straight minutes on top (58'-73'), when both goals came. Even after Kompany's 76' triple change: 4 shots, 0 on target, 0.15 xG.
